title: pi-foreman configuration
description: One config layer or the merged result. Layers: L1 defaults, L3 organisation package, L2 <agent dir>/foreman.json, project .pi/foreman.json (trusted only, may only tighten safety.*), session. Merge is plain last-wins per key.

profile.description: The setup profile recorded by `foreman setup` (orchestration, standard or full); null = none chosen yet. User or overlay config only.

rankTiers.description: Preset template only (config/presets/inexpensive.json): roles named by rank tier, resolved to models by `foreman config apply-preset` and removed from the written file. The runtime never reads it.

displayNames.description: A preset name from displayPresets ("classic" or "plain" ship in L1) or a per-id map {role id: display name}. Display names are cosmetic; no code compares them.

displayPresets.description: Named display-name presets, each a map {role id: display name}.

roles.description:
Per-role settings keyed by neutral role id (planner, explorer, builder, reviewer, senior-reviewer, finalizer, foreman, or an overlay role). `session-foreman` is not a launchable role: providers.

.roles.session-foreman.model is the model of sessions opened by `foreman session open` (default: the opening session's own model; `--model` overrides).

file.description: Path of a role file that replaces the prompt (L2/L3 only).

promptAppend.description: Text appended to the role prompt.

tools.description: Strict tool allowlist. Written as a JSON array into the generated settings. For the foreman it is informational. A project or session can only narrow it (intersection), and cannot add role ids.

denyTools.description: Tool-name globs (`*` wildcard) a child of this role never gets: the call is denied, never asked. Defaults deny mcp__* for the read-only roles. Layers add to the list; none removes an entry.

mcp.description: Ceiling of MCP servers a child of this role may load on demand through tool_search, by configured name: `server` for all its tools, `server/tool` for one. Declared up front only on a `mcp.directProviders` provider (its allowed deferred tools are preloaded); a launch `mcp` field can narrow it. User or overlay config only. Refused where the role's denyTools deny mcp__*.

skills.description: Skills this role gets as catalog entries, by name: one plain path segment (no / or \, not . or .., no glob characters, no colon). A role gets only the skills it names; inheritSkills stays off. Default none. User or overlay config only.

codemode.description:
Add the codemode tool to this role. Overridden per provider by providers.

.roles..codemode.

launch.description: How the role is launched. Only detached is supported: detached children forward permission asks to the parent. A project or session cannot set it.

timeoutMinutes.description: Run-time default of one launch of this role: the adapter writes it as the launch's timeoutMs when the launch sets none. A launch timeoutMs wins in either direction, capped at ceremony.launchTimeoutCapMinutes. A project or session can only lower it.

strongAbove.description:
Ladder: context tokens (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite of one call) above which a child of this role on its bottom rung is steered to stop and hand off for a strong relaunch. Wins over providers.

.strongAbove and ladder.strongAbove. User or overlay config only.

childMaxTurns.description:
Ladder: assistant turns after which a child of this role is steered once to stop: on its bottom rung with a RUNG_UP: turns handoff (climb-eligible), on its top rung to report. Wins over providers.

.childMaxTurns and ladder.childMaxTurns. User or overlay config only.

strongOnRevision.description:
Ladder: climb this role to its strong rung on a revision after a reviewer FAIL (see ladder.strongOnRevision). Wins over providers.

.strongOnRevision and ladder.strongOnRevision. A project or session can only set false.

providers.description: Provider map keyed by Pi provider id (for example github-copilot, openrouter). L1 ships none; overlays supply it.

costTier.description: Relative cost tier. A fallback to a higher tier needs one confirmation per session.

roles.description: Role to model map for this provider.

model.description: Full model id as Pi expects it, for example <provider>/<model>.

codemode.description: Per role and provider override of roles.<id>.codemode.

strong.description: Stronger model for this role, picked by the strength keyword "strong" (the builder also on a heavy tier). User or overlay config only; a project or session value is ignored.

idle.description: Cheaper model for the foreman role while the cache is cold (idle downshift). User or overlay config only; a project or session value is ignored. Unset: off.

strongAbove.description: Ladder: strongAbove for every role on this provider (see roles.<id>.strongAbove). User or overlay config only.

childMaxTurns.description: Ladder: childMaxTurns for every role on this provider (see roles.<id>.childMaxTurns). User or overlay config only.

ranks.description: Model ranks for ladder.childPolicy, highest first: {match: model-id glob (* and ?; with a slash it matches <provider>/<id>), tier: 0 = top}. Tiers are compared across providers; a model in no provider's list is unranked. User or overlay config only.

modelDataFrom.description: Provider whose Pi registry file supplies price tiers for this provider's models when Pi has no registry file for it (a bridge provider an extension registers at runtime); the context window comes from Pi's live model list (`pi --list-models`). Built in: claude-bridge uses anthropic. `foreman setup` reads it (docs/install.md, "What setup writes for compaction"). User or overlay config only.

models.description: Models Pi's own registry does not list, keyed by model id (no provider prefix): context window and optional price tiers. `foreman setup` derives a compaction point for each (docs/install.md, "What setup writes"). Any config layer; a project value reaches setup only with `--project`.

tiers.description: Price tiers: a request above inputTokensAbove input tokens is billed at a higher rate.

strongOnRevision.description: true: relaunch the builder on its strong model for every revision round (rung_up reason revision); false: no climb, also not after a reviewer FAIL. Unset: ladder.strongOnRevision decides. Wins over ladder.strongOnRevision. A project or session can only set false.

cache.description: Prompt-cache policy of this provider (idle-cache): TTL, billing and the keep-alive that stops an idle session resuming cold. Built-in values exist for known providers; a key set here wins. User or overlay config sets everything; a project or session can only switch keepalive.enabled off or shorten keepalive.windowMinutes.

ttlSeconds.description: Prompt-cache time to live in seconds; null = unknown (the policy stays off). Built-in: 300 for claude-bridge. User or overlay config only.

billing.description: How the provider bills: per token (a cold cache costs tokens) or per request (the keep-alive is never used). Built-in: token for claude-bridge, request for github-copilot. User or overlay config only.

byModel.description: Per-model rows layered over ttlSeconds and billing: the first row whose match (glob with * or ?, else a substring of the model id) fits the active model wins. A row with billing request never gets a keep-alive. User or overlay config only.

keepalive.description: Keep-alive pings that renew the cache while the session is idle.

enabled.description: Default true iff billing is token and ttlSeconds is below 3600. A project or session can only set false.

intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between pings. Default 90% of ttlSeconds, at least 30. User or overlay config only.

windowMinutes.description: Minutes of idleness after which the pings stop (default 45; Pi's own idle cap is 30). A project or session can only shorten it.

budgetShare.description: Warm budget per idle: the warms may cost at most this share of one cold re-cache of the prompt (default 0.5). A project or session can only lower it (at most 0.5).

awayTicks.description: Warms allowed per idle while the owner is away (presence.awayAfterMinutes); default 0. A project or session can only lower it (at most 0).

whileWaiting.description: Child runs, waits and launch waits do not stop the warms (default true). A project or session can only set false.

beyondPiCap.description: pi-foreman sends the warms itself past Pi's 30-minute idle cap for long TTLs (default true; needs keepalive.enabled). A project or session can only set false.

selfWarmWindowMinutes.description: Minutes of idleness after which the self-sent warms stop (default max(45, 3 x TTL minutes)). A project or session can only shorten it (at most 180).

compactMinTokens.description: Smallest context (tokens) at which a warm compaction (budget, away or window trigger) runs; below it the session goes cold instead. Default 100000; 0 = no minimum. A project or session can only raise it (at least 100000).

warmCompact.description: Warm the cache after a compaction (default true). User or overlay config only.

review.description: Model review of permission asks (link foreman-review) while this provider is active. Without it every ask goes to the human. Ignored in the project and session layers (it loosens).

model.description: Reviewer model, <provider>/<model> or a bare model id of this provider.

timeoutMs.description: Review timeout in ms (default 15000); a timeout defers to the human.

fallback.description: One explicit fallback provider that resolves roles this provider does not map. Used only on auth failure or unavailability.

provider.description: Provider id whose map is used for roles missing here.

confirm.description: Ask once per session before using the fallback.

ladder.description: Role ladder (model -> strong) and the rank policy for child models. User or overlay config only, except strongOnRevision (a project or session can only set false).

strongAbove.description: Default context limit of a bottom-rung child (L1: 100000).

childMaxTurns.description: Default assistant-turn cap of a child (L1: 60).

strongOnRevision.description:
A builder revision launched after a reviewer FAIL goes to the builder's strong rung (rung_up reason review_fail; L1: true). No-op without a strong rung. Overridden by providers.

.strongOnRevision and roles..strongOnRevision. A project or session can only set false.

idleDownshift.description:
Idle model downshift (docs/cache.md; needs providers.

.roles.foreman.idle). A notice turn that starts on a cold cache runs on the idle rung; the owner's next input restores the base model.

enabled.description: false switches the downshift off (L1: true). A project or session can only set false.

causes.description: Turn causes that may downshift (L1: child, wake, intercom, other). A project or session can only remove entries.

sizing.description: Launch sizing: a builder launch's size and risk fields pick its rung (docs/ladder.md; L1: enabled). Sizing only raises the rung; an explicit lower model needs a reason. User or overlay config only.

enabled.description: Read size/risk on builder launches and apply the rules (L1: true). false: the fields are stripped and ignored.

largeFileLines.description: A named file over this many measured lines sends the builder to strong (L1: 1500).

maxModules.description: More components than this (first two directory segments; root files, docs, *.md and test dirs excluded) send the builder to strong (L1: 2).

strongRisks.description: Risk tags that send the builder to strong and ask the next item or pre-pr reviewer for bypass probes (L1: guard, permission, parser, concurrency, security).

topRisks.description: Risk tags that send the builder to the top rung (L1: design).

topRung.description:
Model of the top rung, /[:]. Unset: the next rank above the builder's strong rung (providers.

.ranks), else strong. Subject to ladder.childPolicy; a refused top falls back to strong.

maxTurns.description: Assistant-turn cap per role (L1: builder 100); wins over childMaxTurns, which stays the fallback for roles without an entry. A child that reaches it traces child_turn_limit. User or overlay config only.

rolePolicy.description: Per-role override of childPolicy, e.g. {"reviewer": "at-or-below", "builder": "below"}. Unset role = childPolicy. User or overlay config only.

childPolicy.description:
Which child models a foreman may launch by providers.

.ranks: below = strictly lower tier than the foreman's model (default), at-or-below = the same tier too, any = no check. Inert while no provider has ranks.

reviewerClimb.description: The reviewer's own climb (docs/ladder.md; L1: enabled false). User or overlay config only.

enabled.description: true: the second FAIL of the same ledger item across reviewer runs sends the next reviewer launch to roles.reviewer.strong (rung_up reason review_fail_repeat), and a security-shaped diff sends it to securityRung (reason security).

securityRung.description:
Model of a reviewer launch on a security-shaped diff, /[:]. Unset: the mapped model in the next rank above the reviewer's strong rung (providers.

.ranks), else no extra climb. Not subject to ladder.childPolicy.

research.description: Research launches (docs/ladder.md; L1: factCriticalRung null). User or overlay config only.

factCriticalRung.description: Model of an explorer launch tagged [fact-critical], <provider>/<model>[:<level>]. Unset: the security rung (ladder.reviewerClimb.securityRung, else the default security rung), else the role's strong rung. Not subject to ladder.childPolicy.

reviewPanel.description: Shadow reviewers launched beside the primary reviewer on gate occasions; their findings never block (L1: off). User or overlay config only.

shadows.description: Shadow reviewer models, <provider>/<model>[:<level>]. Empty = panel off.

gates.description: Review occasions that get the panel (L1: [pre-pr]).

visible.description: Show the shadow findings block to the foreman (L1: true).

waitSeconds.description: Seconds a gate's panel waits for its shadow reviews after the primary review ended; then it composes without the missing ones (L1: 600).

childMaxThinking.description: Ceiling for every child launch's thinking level (ladder rungs included), applied on top of maxThinking. Unset = no extra cap.

quiet.description: Silence the interactive first-run notice that points at the model presets (default false). The notice appears only while no role or review model is configured.

maxThinking.description: Ceiling for every role's thinking level.

default.description: Tier assumed when no signal applies.

heavySignals.description: Keywords or areas that make a task heavy.

heavyFileCount.description: A task touching more files than this is heavy.

revisionRounds.description: Builder revision rounds after a review, per tier (trivial has none). A project or session can only lower each value.

requireTriage.description: The foreman records a tier before it edits workspace files itself. A project or session can only set true.

trivialBound.description: How much the foreman may change itself at tier trivial (project files outside .workflow/, counted per session): distinct files, changed lines (added + removed) and new files. A call that would exceed any of them is refused and the tier escalates to standard. A project or session can only lower each value.

required.description: Steps a session at this tier completes before the foreman may finish: planner (a planner run that completed), builder (a builder run that completed), reviewer (see reviewGate), finalizer (a finalizer run that completed). A project or session can only add steps.

trivial.description: Naming builder turns on the trivial builder path: a trivial task keeps its ledger and one builder on the default model makes the change; at finish a diff check (one source file within trivialBound, no exported signature or schema change, no test file touched, a test present) escalates to standard otherwise. Applies once a ledger is bound; builder is dropped in bounded mode. [] restores the earlier trivial tier (no builder).

foremanEdits.description: What the foreman may change itself: readonly = only .workflow/; scratchpad = .workflow/ and ceremony.scratchDir; bounded = workspace files at tier trivial within ceremony.trivialBound. A refused edit raises a trivial tier to standard. A project or session can only tighten it (readonly < scratchpad < bounded).

scratchDir.description: Workspace-relative folder the foreman may write in scratchpad mode (notes, drafts, commit messages). Not absolute, no '..', not the workspace root, must resolve inside the workspace. A project or session can only narrow it to a subfolder.

reviewBeforePr.description: A pull/merge request needs a reviewer PASS on the current HEAD. A project or session can only set true.

foremanReads.description: Read budget of the foreman's own read-class calls (bash, read, grep, find, ls, codemode; a codemode script counts once) per phase: before = until the first child launch, after = since the latest launch. The foreman's reads are never refused: at warn the result carries a reminder to delegate, and again after every `every` further reads. A project or session can only lower each value. `deny` is deprecated and ignored (accepted so existing configs still validate).

deny.description: Deprecated and ignored: the read budget never refuses a read.
Deprecated and ignored: the read budget never refuses a read.

childReads.description: Read budget per child role (read, grep, find, ls and read-only bash calls of one child run; a role without an entry has no budget). At warn the result tells the child to wrap up; above deny the call is refused and the child returns its report with what it has (STATUS: stuck if it cannot finish). Defaults: builder 20/40, reviewer 15/30, explorer exempt. A launch with size.files above 3 adds perFile (builder 5, reviewer 2) per extra file to its deny, and a launch field `reads` sets it directly; both are capped at max (120).

perFile.description: Reads added to the deny per file beyond 3 in the launch's size.files.

max.description: Upper bound of a launch's read deny (default 120).

childScratch.description: Per-launch child scratch dir <os temp dir>/pi-foreman-scratch/<session>/<launch> (mode 0700), named in the task and as env FOREMAN_SCRATCH; the harness removes it when the run ends and sweeps the session's dirs at shutdown.

keep.description: true = keep the scratch dirs after the run and at shutdown (inspection). Any layer may set it: it only retains temporary data.

planReviewMax.description: `[plan-review]` runs per plan topic per session before the owner decides at the checkpoint (default 4).

recheckBudget.description: Read-class calls the foreman may make after a reviewer PASS before it is told to finish. A project or session can only lower it.

launchWait.description: block = a launch's tool result waits for the child to end; detach = it returns at once. A project or session can only move to block.

dedupeNotify.description: Replace a subagent-notify message whose result was already delivered with a one-line stub. A project or session can only set true.

reviewGate.description: When the required reviewer step holds. pass = the latest reviewer or senior-reviewer verdict is PASS (APPROVE) and no builder launch or foreman project-file edit came after it; a FAIL (BLOCK), a review without a verdict or such a revision re-opens it. verdict = any verdict, PASS or FAIL. A project or session can only move to pass.

orientation.description: Orientation packet appended to the foreman's system prompt once per session (tracked-file tree to depth 2, head of AGENTS.md or README.md, detected build/test commands, explorer hint). Not a tool call, so it does not count against the read budget. enabled false = nothing injected.

ledgerHelper.description: How the foreman manages its ledger. tool = the foreman_ledger tool (batched marks, returns ledger status, not counted against recheckBudget; closes V only after a reviewer PASS with no revision since, with --verifier) and reviewer / senior-reviewer children get foreman_ledger for marking V only; bash = the shell command ledger, a pure-ledger command is not counted against recheckBudget, ledger defer is allowlisted; off = as before (every ledger shell call counts). A project or session can only move toward off (off < bash < tool).

reviewPerRevision.description: true = a reviewer or senior-reviewer launch is refused while the last review passed and nothing was revised since, unless the task carries [second-opinion]; false = no refusal (as before). A project or session can only set true.

reviewRuns.description: Review runs (reviewer, senior-reviewer; not panel shadows) the foreman may launch per user prompt; the next launch is refused [review_cap]. A re-review after a FAIL gets the line `[re-review items: N, M]` and must list those items. A project or session can only lower it.

budgetUsd.description: Cap in USD on the summed cost estimate of the session (the foreman plus all its runs, list prices): a launch over it is refused [budget_exceeded], a warning comes at 80 %. null = no cap. A project or session can only lower it.

reviewModel.description: Reviewer model used when a reviewer launch resolves to the foreman's own model and neither roles.reviewer nor its strong rung differs, <provider>/<model>[:<level>]. null = none. User or overlay config only.

reviewByOccasion.description: Per-occasion reviewer overrides (docs/review.md): thinking level and/or model of a reviewer launch for that occasion, applied after the role map and before the different-model rule. User or overlay config only.

planReview.description: Per tier: the checkpoint needs a [plan-review] verdict for the current plan first (L1: heavy only). A project or session can only set true.

checkpoint.description: Who answers foreman_checkpoint. parent: the verdict comes from the parent-written ruling-plan.md in the session's handoff dir (first line APPROVED, REVISE <text> or REJECT, written after the last plan edit); no dialog. human: the dialog, only when attended. Unset: parent for a session opened with a parent (handoff dir and parent intercom id set), else human. User or overlay config only.

planReviewRounds.description: Plan-review rounds per plan before the checkpoint opens with the open findings visible (a FAIL below the cap goes back to the planner; a FAIL at the cap opens the checkpoint). Counted per plan version: an appended ruling, decision log or addendum is not a new version. Default 2. Free per layer.

planner.description: Who writes the heavy plan. self (default) = the foreman writes .workflow/scratch/plan-<topic>.md itself and its approved checkpoint satisfies the planner step; role = a planner launch is required, but a planner whose rank tier is <= the foreman's (unranked counts as not below) switches the session to self at the launch attempt. [plan-review] stays mandatory at heavy on both paths. Free per layer.

childTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-tool-call timeout of planner, builder, reviewer, senior-reviewer and finalizer runs (pi-subagents toolTimeoutMs); a run deadline timeoutMs below it is raised to it. Default 1800. A project or session can only lower it.

launchTimeoutCapMinutes.description: The only hard ceiling on a child run deadline, in minutes: the role timeoutMinutes is the default and a launch timeoutMs wins, but no written deadline exceeds this. Default 120. A project or session can only lower it.

childBashTimeoutSeconds.description: Default timeout in seconds of a child's bash call that names no timeout. Capped at childBashTimeoutMaxSeconds. Default 600. Free per layer.

childBashTimeoutMaxSeconds.description: Cap in seconds on the timeout a child's bash call names. The effective ceiling is the lower of this and childTimeoutSeconds (the per-tool-call limit of the child run). Default 1800. Free per layer.

heavyThreshold.description: strict = heavy is for multi-component or risky changes (prompt criteria); heavySignals keyword hits in a request are only a hint to the foreman; heavyFileCount still escalates. eee843d = the old prompt line and keyword auto-escalation. A project or session can only move toward eee843d.

critic.description: Questions rendered into every reviewer and senior-reviewer task; the review answers each once per ledger item as a line `CRITIC: <item> Q<k>: <answer>`. The harness does not parse the lines. Empty list = no block. Default: the four owner questions.

repos.description: Repositories the sync routine pulls. User or overlay config only.

paths.description: Glob patterns of the paths to sync.

runRetro.description: Run the retro step during sync.

doneTtlMinutes.description: Minutes after which radar hides a finished session and deletes its presence file.

recentRunSeconds.description: Seconds a finished subagent run stays on the Herdr sidebar's children line (as done glyph + role) before it joins the done count.

proposalMinReviews.description: Reviews needed before a retro proposal. User or overlay config only.

enabled.description: Run retro and record backlog findings. null means auto: on in interactive (tui, rpc) sessions, off in json and print mode.

workspaceKey.description: Backlog key of this workspace ('/' makes subdirectories). null means <basename>-<hash of the workspace root>. User or overlay config only.

backlogDir.description: Central backlog directory. null means <agentDir>/pi-foreman/state/retro/backlog. User or overlay config only.

repoBacklog.description: Workspaces (absolute path or glob) whose backlog lives in <workspace>/.workflow/retro-backlog.md. commit: true lets sync commit it. User or overlay config only.

expireDays.description: Days without a sighting after which an open or planned backlog entry expires.

askThreshold.description: Permission asks in one run that make a backlog finding.

panelThreshold.description: Unique accepted findings of a shadow reviewer model that make a review-model backlog candidate. User or overlay config only.

allowRemote.description: Allow remote intercom. A project or session can only set false.

allowOpenPane.description: Allow opening a pane. A project or session can only set false.

from.description: Sources a close request is accepted from. A project or session can only narrow it.

autoClean.description: At close, remove the worktrees and scratch this session created once every precondition passes (default true). A project or session may only set false.

worktreeDir.description: Worktree convention directory; `<repo>` is the main worktree's name, a relative path resolves against the main worktree. `foreman worktree sweep` lists worktrees outside it as off-convention. User or overlay config only.

childWaitMs.description: `/foreman close` also asks this session's open child sessions to close and waits up to this many milliseconds for them (default 60000; 0 = send and do not wait). User or overlay config only.

cacheBar.description: Show the cache-timer bar in the foreman footer: time to cold, warms left and the next idle step.

style.description: Footer in the tui: foreman (default, the two-line pi-foreman footer) or pi (Pi's own footer, the usage line in the one-line status).

statusCommand.description: External status hook for the Herdr sidebar: one command line, split like a POSIX shell, no shell runs. It must print a JSON array of {label, state} objects (state fail, run, ok or none) and exit 0; the items show as extra dots (display data only, never sent to the model). The program must lie outside the workspace. Unset = off. User or overlay config only (the whole sidebar block).

statusSeconds.description: Seconds between two runs of sidebar.statusCommand (default 60). User or overlay config only.

symbols.description: Glyph set for the children widget, radar and the Herdr sidebar: unicode (default, broadest support), emoji, nerd (Nerd Font icons) or ascii.

spinner.description: Animate the working glyph in the children widget and the Herdr sidebar (Pi's braille frames, 250 ms steps). false shows static glyphs everywhere; absent or true animates.

children.description: Show the children widget (subagent runs and opened sessions) below the editor in the tui.

prs.description: Show the PR widget (tracked PRs and the shared watch summary) above the editor in the tui. /foreman prs cycles auto, collapsed and hidden for the session.

prLinks.description: Make the PR labels of the widget terminal hyperlinks (OSC 8) to the PR page; false renders plain labels.

blockedShim.description: Show any open Pi dialog or permission ask as blocked in Herdr (steps aside once Herdr's Pi integration does it natively).

groupTag.description: Tag opened sessions' Herdr panes with their parent and the parent's pane with its child count.

backend.description: Where a local `foreman session open` runs the child (default `auto`): `herdr` when HERDR_PANE_ID is set and herdr is found, else herdr-core (`hc run`) when HC_TERMINAL_ID is set and hc is found, else the printed command. `herdr`, `hc` and `terminal` force one; a forced backend that cannot run is refused. Experimental for hc. User or overlay config only.

hc.description: herdr-core settings of `foreman session open`. User or overlay config only.

outliveParent.description: Pass `--outlive-parent` to `hc run`, so a child survives the end of the parent terminal (default true: a parent crash never kills a child with uncommitted work). false lets hc end the child with its parent.

machines.description: Machines `foreman session open --machine` may open a child on, keyed by the Herdr saved-machine name (A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -, at most 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit). User or overlay config only.

returnPath.description: How this machine's child sessions report back (default `pull`): `pull` has the parent fetch an outbox in the handoff dir over its own SSH connection and needs nothing on the remote side; `push` uses pi-intercom's cross-machine relay from the remote (it needs this machine saved in the remote's Herdr and the relay command on the SSH PATH).

foremanCommand.description: The foreman command on the remote machine, run over SSH (default `foreman`); no spaces, no leading dash. Use an absolute path when the SSH PATH does not hold it.

parentName.description: This machine's name as the remote machine's Herdr and pi-intercom know it (default: pi-intercom's `crossMachine.machineName`, else the lowercased short hostname).

remoteInlineMaxBytes.description: Bytes of a result or plan a remote child's notice carries inline (default 32768); a project or session can only lower it.

pull.description: Polling of remote pull sessions' outboxes. User or overlay config only.

intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between two polls of an open pull session (default 20).

fastSeconds.description: Seconds between two polls while an ask is open, the session is closing, or shortly after an open or a brief (default 5).

ssh.description: SSH settings of the parent's remote calls. User or overlay config only.

controlMaster.description: On POSIX parents, add ControlMaster/ControlPath/ControlPersist options to every SSH call so polls reuse one connection (default true). Windows parents ignore it; false adds nothing.

maxTokens.description: Cap in tokens on where `foreman setup` makes Pi compact (written as Pi's compaction.modelOverrides); null for no cap. A project can only lower it; a project null is dropped.

maxSeconds.description: A project or session can only lower it.

maxActive.description: A project or session can only lower it.

ci.description: A project or session can only set false.

presence.description:
Presence gate of the cache warms: the owner counts as away after awayAfterMinutes without keyboard or mouse input; warms while away are limited by providers.

.cache.keepalive.awayTicks. A failed probe counts as present.

enabled.description: Probe the idle input time (default true). A project or session can only set true.

awayAfterMinutes.description: Minutes without input after which the owner counts as away (default 11). A project or session can only lower it.

command.description: A command that prints the seconds since the last input, replacing the platform probe. User or overlay config only (it runs a program).

resources.description: Host pressure limits. A project file may only tighten them.

maxLoadPerCore.description: 5-minute load average per core above which pressure is high. A project can only lower it.

minFreeMemMB.description: Free memory below which pressure is high. A project can only raise it.

minFreeDiskGB.description: Free workspace disk below which pressure is high. A project can only raise it.

sampleSeconds.description: Sampling interval. A project file cannot set it.

gate.description: The tool gate (gate.ts) that decides every tool call.

mode.description: Temporary, until the permission redesign. full (default): the whole gate. floors-only: only the floors decide (plus the unclear-push deny); every other tool call runs without review, dialog or ask. User config or overlay only; a project value is dropped.

reviewTimeoutMs.description: Timeout of the review model call in ms (default 15000); a timeout defers to the ask path.

askTimeoutMs.description: How long a child waits for its parent's ruling-<n>.md before the call is denied, in ms (default 900000). The value only bounds a child's ask wait; a session opened by another session asks in its own pane and has no timeout while the owner is present.

childAsk.description: Where a subagent child's policy ask goes: the parent's pane (via an ask file the parent answers) or a deny; headless sessions always deny. Default parent.

tmpAccess.description: Writes (and for the owner reads) under the OS temp dirs are allowed (default true).

logMaxBytes.description: Size at which the gate log rotates (default 20971520, 20 MB).

userFile.description: The user's own policy file (absolute, ~/... or relative to the agent dir); null = none.

safety.description: Safety policy. An invalid value in a layer is dropped from that layer with a warning; the other layers still apply. The project layer can only tighten it.

files.description: Extra policy files of the owner's overlay, merged after the shipped and the user policy: absolute, ~/... or relative to the agent dir.

requiredChildExtensions.description: Extension paths every child must load. A project can add entries, not remove them.

mayPush.description: Whether children may push. A project can only set false.

required.description: Require a review before close-out. A project can only set true.

protectedBranches.description: Branches (fnmatch patterns) that never receive a force push, mirror push or delete from the foreman. A project can add entries, not remove them.

messagePattern.description: Python regular expression the commit subject must match (re.search). null switches the check off. A project cannot set it.

requiredTrailers.description: Regular expressions; each must match one trailer line (Key: value) of the message. A project can add entries, not remove them.

forbiddenTrailers.description: Regular expressions no trailer line may match. A project can add entries, not remove them.

checkCommand.description: argv of a command run before each foreman commit, with the staged diff on stdin and the message in PI_FOREMAN_COMMIT_MESSAGE; a non-zero exit blocks the commit. It executes a program, so only the organisation and user layers may set it; a project value is ignored.

copyMaxBytes.description: Size cap for foreman_copy. A project can only lower it.

worktreeDisposable.description: Path components whose ignored files foreman_worktree_remove may delete ('name/' = a directory). A project cannot set it.

baseBranch.description: Base branch for the merged check of foreman_worktree_remove; null = origin HEAD, else main, else master. A project cannot set it.

allowWorkflow.description: Let subagent workflow scripts and schedule.* actions through; they can launch any agent with any model, unchecked by the role allowlist and the role map. Loosening key: L1, overlays and the user file only; project and session values are ignored.

preBash.description: Pre-bash hook extension point. A project or session cannot set it (a hook runs code).

hooks.description: Ordered hooks run before every bash tool call. An entry ending .mjs, .cjs or .js is a module (absolute path, or relative to the agent dir) whose default export or preBash(input) returns { block: true, reason } to block; any other entry is a command (split on whitespace, no shell) that gets the input JSON {command, cwd, tool, session, role} on stdin and blocks with exit 2 (stderr = reason). A hook can only block, never allow.

strict.description: false (default) = fail-open: a hook error (throw, other exit code, start failure, 5 s timeout) is traced as prebash_hook_error and ignored. true = a hook error blocks the bash call.

preconditionOps.description: Settings for the precondition-checked operations. A project cannot set it.

isolateClaudeConfig.description: Point CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR at an empty pi-foreman folder so the claude bridge ignores the host's Claude Code settings, hooks, plugins and CLAUDE.md. auto = on when the active provider is claude-bridge. A project cannot set it.

promptCacheTtl.description: Claude Code prompt-cache TTL on the claude bridge, per Pi process kind: main (the foreman and session foremen) and subagent (children). 1h or 5m set CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL; inherit leaves the variable alone and the cache policy assumes 300 s. Defaults: main 1h, subagent 5m. User and overlay config only; a project cannot set it.

directProviders.description: Provider ids that fix a turn's tool list at its first request (pi-claude-bridge): a deferred MCP tool that tool_search loads mid-turn is never callable there. For a child on such a provider its allowed deferred MCP tools are loaded before the first prompt, so they are callable at once (the prompt grows by their schemas; trace event mcp_child_direct). Unset = ["claude-bridge"]; [] turns it off. User or overlay config only.

path.description: Python interpreter (3.13 or newer). null means auto-detect. It runs every guard, so a project or session value is ignored.

enabled.description: Write the allowlisted trace. null means it follows the effective retro.enabled; false always turns it off.

dir.description: Trace directory. null means the state dir. A project or session value must resolve inside the workspace, else it is ignored.

paths.description: Extra places the foreman and its children may read (docs/permissions.md, Hub ledger read).

hubWorkflow.description: Absolute dir, or list of dirs, whose `.workflow/` path family (the hub's ledger and notes) is readable, read-only, for the foreman and its children in a round worktree: the read tool and read-only bash, no dialog. Writes stay denied. Default none. User or overlay config only; a project or session value is ignored with a warning.

git.description: true = the git tool pack: git_status, git_log, git_diff_stat, git_branch_state for the foreman and for children whose role has bash. User or overlay config; the project and session layers may only set false. Re-run foreman setup after a change.

pr.description: true (default) = the PR tools pr_create, pr_status, pr_checks, pr_comments, pr_watch, pr_track and pr_untrack for the foreman; children whose role has bash get the read tools. The host comes from tools.prHost. The project and session layers may only set false. Re-run foreman setup after a change.

prDots.description: false = the PR status dots poller (sidebar dots and the external status hook) never starts, while the PR tools stay on. Default true.

prHost.description: Host CLI for the PR tools: "auto" (gh, then glab, found on PATH outside the workspace), "gh", "glab", or an object of command templates with the keys create, status, checks, comments, find and search (docs/tools.md#host-templates). User or overlay config only.

prInteractions.description: Extra command patterns that register a pull request once the command exits 0 (docs/tools.md#registration-paths). User or overlay config only; none ship.

pattern.description: Regular expression (flag u) matched against each command segment, with the named group n (the PR number) and optional groups repo (owner/name) and host.

prShared.description: Shared PR watch: one leader session per machine polls the PR host and publishes a snapshot every session shows (docs/tools.md#shared-pr-watch). User or overlay config only.

enabled.description: true = run the shared watch (default false).

authors.description: Authors (users or bots) whose open pull requests with a failed check show as failing (default none).

seconds.description: Seconds between two polls of each source, a floor for every endpoint (default 180).

events.description: true (default) = also read the user's events feed to register pull requests touched elsewhere.
